::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Febry 3d [1864]  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS NLS 966 f.381
:::

Dear [Dr Neale](people/person_1078.qmd),

I enclose postage stamps for the paper taken up by the Honolulu letters.[^1] Pray thank [Sister Anne](people/person_1816.qmd) for her kind note to me acknowledging the pin cushions.

yours faithfully
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Black-edged paper.
[^2]: Queen [Emma](people/person_485.qmd) of Hawaii visited Hursley in August 1865, and the Honolulu letters may have been in connection with this.
